title: Chapter 222: Nemesis Of The Skeleton Tribe
content:
Chapter 222: Nemesis Of The Skeleton Tribe

What Wu Qing saw was a bunch of skeletons!

"Skeleton? Undead?"

This surprised Wu Qing!

Opposite the Naga army are more than 100,000 skeletons.

There are melee skeleton warriors with bone swords, bone axes and bone shields, skeleton archers with bone longbows and bone arrows, and skeleton mages with bone magic staffs and tattered cloaks.

They are all the undead troops in Wu Qing’s impression!

These skeleton soldiers all have white and shiny bones, with two groups of ghostly soul fire flickering in their eye sockets. Their movements are no different from ordinary people, and their aura is very extraordinary.

"The one opposite is an undead race?"

Wu Qing asked Nagasa through Host No. 3.

"They are a clan of skeletons who believe in the evil god of death. The whole clan has skeletons like this!"

"They have various types of troops and are powerful. They are a very difficult group of guys!"

Nagaya explained.

"I think the attack characteristics of the Zerg Destroyer should be very effective against the Skeleton Tribe!"

"If my guess is verified later, the cooperation between our two races will continue to deepen!"

Nagaya is blunt.

If the Zerg Destroyer performs well on the battlefield, she will go to Wu Qing to hire more Zerg Destroyer.

"No problem, I also look forward to deepening cooperation between the two races!"

Of course Wu Qing has no problem. As long as the Naga tribe is willing to give enough luck beads, they can send as many Zerg destroyers to Naga.

The Zerg Destroyer fighting in the Naga tribe can also convert the enemies destroyed by the system into resources. This ability of the system is not restricted by geography.

This is a good thing that kills multiple birds with one stone.

On the battlefield, the Naga army and the Skeleton army advanced simultaneously. Naga ordered the Naga army to stop first.

With the ultra-long-range Zerg Destroyer, Nagaya is ready to take advantage of the range. She will attack with the Zerg Destroyer first. The Naga army will stick to the formation and wait for the Skeleton army to attack.

The Naga army stopped, and the Skeleton army also stopped. The two sides had fought countless times, and their routines were very familiar to each other.

The commander of the Skeleton Tribe felt that the Naga Tribe army wanted to wait for work, and they did not want to give the Naga Tribe this opportunity. They also stopped and refused to fight until they were within combat distance.

The Skeleton Army does not need to eat, drink or defecate. Time is meaningless to them. Compared with the Naga Army, the Skeleton Army lacks the most patience.

Unfortunately, this time the skeleton army commander miscalculated.

The Zerg Destroyers in the Naga army do not require pre-war preparation like the Goblin creations, and can fire at any time and anywhere.

"Target skeleton archers and skeleton mages! Attack with all your strength!"

Nagaya issued a combat order to Host No. 3.

Host No. 3 took off in person to enhance target information for the Zerg Destroyer.

"Boom boom boom...!"

More than 10,000 liquid fireball shells soared into the sky and flew towards the skeleton army in the distance.

The skeleton mage commander riding on the skeleton war horse pointed upward with the bone finger of his left hand, and the skeleton archers and skeleton mage launched an attack on the liquid fireball shells flying at high speed.

The powerful bone arrows fired by the skeleton archers are densely packed. There are two kinds of skeleton mages, one shoots fireballs like the flame demon, and the other shoots green poisonous balloons.

Bone arrows, fireballs, poison balloons, and the liquid fireballs launched by the Zerg destroyers criss-crossed in the air!

There seemed to be a large number of bone arrows, fireballs and poisonous balloons, but they were very rare in the sky. Successfully hitting the high-speed flying liquid fireballs depended purely on luck.

Moreover, the liquid fireball shells launched by the Zerg Destroyers are very stable and will not explode in advance unless they receive a powerful blow from the front.

Some of the bone arrows, fireballs, and poison balloons launched by the skeleton army were lucky enough to hit the liquid fireballs, but they just passed by and had no effect at all.

"Boom boom...!"

A small number of unlucky liquid fireball shells exploded in the air.

Because the ballistic trajectory of the liquid fireball shells launched by the Zerg Destroyers is a throwing arc, the trajectory is very high. When the Skeleton Army can intercept it, these shells are already in the sky above the Skeleton Army.

The liquid fireball shell exploded in the air, and the hot corrosive liquid sprayed everywhere, falling towards the skeleton army below.

"Rumble...!"

What fell faster than these splashes of corrosive slime were the more liquid fireball shells that were not intercepted. They fell into the team of skeleton archers and skeleton mages in the skeleton army, and exploded violently. .

Energy shock, high-temperature flames, corrosive mucus adhesion damage, etc., swept across the hard-boned skeleton soldiers.

The skeleton structure of the skeleton soldiers has a good resistance to energy impacts, but the resistance to damage from high-temperature flames and corrosive mucus is much weaker.

An army of more than 100,000 people was relatively small. More than 10,000 liquid fireball bombs were concentrated among a limited number of skeleton archers and skeleton mages. The effect of concentrated fire attacks was quite obvious.

In the area where the liquid fireball shells fired by the high-star Zerg Destroyers exploded, whether they were skeleton archers or skeleton mages, they all turned into light and disappeared.

In the area attacked by the one-star Zerg Destroyer, only the Skeleton soldiers in the center of the explosion disappeared in part, and most of them were defending their heads to resist the damage of the explosion to the soul fire in their skulls.

These star-level Skeleton soldiers have energy in their bones, which are more crystal-like when resisting attacks, and look like pieces of art.

Skeleton mages can also manipulate energy to form an external energy shield, and their defensive capabilities are stronger than those of Skeleton Archers.

However, the defense state of Skeleton Soldiers cannot last long, and after the liquid fireball bomb of the Zerg Destroyer explodes, the corrosive mucus will cause continuous damage.

Once the energy and protective shields on the Skeleton Soldiers are retracted, the extremely sticky and corrosive hot mucus that explodes everywhere quickly corrodes their bones on the Skeleton Soldiers' bodies and feet.

Burning, corrosive and sticky, it has a miraculous effect on the bones of the Skeletons. Once this mucus sticks to the bones, the energy in the bones will quickly drain away, and the color of the bones will change from white and crystal to gray and black and rotten.

Bones are not flesh, so you can't cut them off even if you want to!

Although this kind of damage will not be fatal at once, it will quickly weaken the combat effectiveness of the Skeletons.

In the round of attacks by the Zerg Destroyers, there are not many Skeletons who died directly, but there are many Skeleton Archers who were injured and could no longer draw their bows and shoot arrows.

Those Skeleton Mages were affected by the corrosive mucus and could not concentrate on spell attacks.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The second round of attacks by the Zerg Destroyers came, and the rumbling explosion sounded again. This time, the Skeleton Archers and Skeleton Mages who could intercept were less than half of the beginning, and the interception effect was even worse.

The two rounds of attacks by the Zerg Destroyers beat the Skeletons' long-range attack troops into a half-crippled state.

The powerful Skeleton Mage riding on the Skeleton Warhorse was protected by a bright energy shield and was not affected at all.

It raised its staff and waved it forward, and the Skeleton Clan's melee soldiers ran forward and began to charge!

The Skeleton Clan's melee soldiers looked like some skeletons, but they ran very steadily and quickly. It can be seen that the weight of their bones is definitely not light, otherwise they would not be able to run so heavy.

The Skeleton Archers and Skeleton Mages who were still able to move also moved quickly, leaving the burning and corrosive mucus everywhere.

The Zerg Destroyer launched two rounds of attacks, and the amount of corrosive mucus carried by the liquid fireballs was very large.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg Destroyer's third round of attacks fell, and this time their target was the charging melee Skeleton Warriors.

The Skeleton Warriors in the front of the Skeleton Clan Army were all subjected to intensive explosion attacks. The huge energy impact disrupted their charging momentum. The terrible burning and corrosive mucus made many Skeleton Warriors lose their ability to move and unable to continue charging.

The skeleton warriors who were unlucky and whose soul fire was damaged turned into light and disappeared.

The distance between the Naga and Skeleton armies was very close. With the charge of the Skeleton army, the distance between the two armies has entered the attack range of ordinary long-range soldiers.

Those Skeleton warriors who were not injured or were slightly injured continued to charge forward.

"Naga warriors! Prepare for long-range attack!"

"Prepare for three consecutive shots! Fire!"

"Switch to melee equipment in the front!"

"..."

The Naga army was skilled in dealing with the charge of the Skeleton army.

All members of the Naga army were equipped with excellent bows and arrows. The three-consecutive rapid-fire of 100,000 Naga warriors fired dense arrows at the front position at the maximum range. This kind of long-range coverage shooting only pays attention to the range and quantity, not the accuracy.

A large number of arrows and the liquid fireball shells fired by the fourth round of Zerg destroyers fell into the charging Skeleton army.

The arrows shot by the Naga tribe's bows are very peculiar, with strong armor-piercing ability. If they are shot on the skeleton of the Skeleton tribe soldiers, the impact is not great, but if they are shot on the skull of the Skeleton tribe soldiers, it is easy to penetrate the skull and damage the soul fire of the Skeleton tribe.

Therefore, the long-range attack of the Naga tribe army has a high mortality rate against the Skeleton tribe army. Either it kills in one hit, or it has no effect.

The super-long-range area killing attack of the Zerg Destroyer, in addition to a good mortality rate, has a great impact on the subsequent combat power of the Skeleton tribe army, causing a large number of injuries and seriously affecting the sustained combat power of the Skeleton tribe army.

"It really works!"

"Under the attack of the Zerg Destroyer, the Skeletons suffered a great increase in casualties and their offensive power was greatly reduced!"

"In the past, to achieve this combat effect, a large number of Goblin creations had to be consumed!"

"Now the Zerg Destroyer can easily do it with a few rounds of attack!"

"They are simply the nemesis of the Skeletons!"

The Naga tribe has seen the effect of the Zerg Destroyer's participation in the battle, and praised the No. 3 host who was flying a little high with satisfaction.

With the participation of the Zerg Destroyer, the combat power of the Naga army has increased exponentially, and it only takes a very small price to destroy the same number of enemies.
